out.description: Output file path, relative to the surface root. export image supports {name}, {frame} (zero-based), {frame1} (one-based), {layer}, {tag}, {tagframe} (zero-based within tag), and {slice}; integer frame fields accept widths such as {frame:02}. Other export subcommands use literal paths.
out.title: Out

overwrite.description: Replace existing output files when true.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

allow_invalid.description: Explicitly export even when validation has errors, recording a warning.
allow_invalid.title: Allow Invalid

format.description: Output format; omit to infer it from the output filename extension.
format.title: Format
